past.company_description: Clara is your partner in doing great work. Clara delivers efficiency and accuracy by combining machine intelligence and an expert team. Communicating with Clara is clear, professional, and not robotic. Just cc Clara as you would if it were your own human executive assistant and ask plain English to help find a time to meet. Clara will respond naturally, find a time, and send calendar invites and reminders.With the currently invite-only Clara Live, Clara can join your meetings and record, take notes, or even schedule a follow up meeting. Clara also integrates with Google Docs, shares meeting notes, creates Asana tickets, and more.
past.description:
Clara Labs is a Series A venture founded in 2014 and subsequently raised ~$12M from investors including The Slack Fund, Sequoia, Greylock, Y-Combinator, First Round Capital and others. Clara was then acquired by Teamable (previously known as TopFunnel) towards the end of 2019.

Clara uses a combination of AI and human-in-the-loop flows to help executives work better. We started with scheduling meetings and are developing new products to help make meetings more actionable.

We want to give all people a way to delegate a substantial portion of their work off to us so that they can focus on what matters most.

Over time, scheduling links have become impersonal and “fit all” and quite frankly - they suck. I hate it when I’m asked to schedule a time from someone’s calendly. The only other option an assistant. That is expensive, and takes time to hire, train, manage. We fix this problem for the world’s top executives.

My role at Clara is to building building engineering/ product roadmaps, help manage priorities, lead hiring efforts but as in the case in many early stage startups, I end up doing a bit of everything!
past.name: Clara Labs
past.title: Building & Scaling Products
